ContractFlavorDef.questDescription: A sobbing mother from [settlement] clutches a torn scarf. Her boy and his sister went to gather berries. Something hairy and fast took them into the pines.
Herders from [settlement] report every sheep in the night pasture torn apart. Not one of their dogs, they swear — a pack of demons on four legs.
Merchants fleeing [settlement] beg you to investigate an overturned cart. Wolves, but wrong — too bold, too many.
Elders at [settlement] will not send woodcutters out. The howling starts at dusk — something that hunts for sport.
A woodcutter from [settlement] says the trees themselves shifted. Roots snatched his partner. It looked like a man made of bark, then only forest again.
Villagers near [settlement] say children who wandered too far were found frozen, staring at nothing. Something old in the grove watches them.
Hunters from [settlement] found their camp surrounded by maddened wolves. One swears he saw twisted wood directing them.
A trader reached [settlement] half-mad. Roots burst through the trail and dragged his mule under. A shape of moss and antlers stood among the oaks.
Miners from [settlement] refuse to return to a hillside dig. A huge hairy beast blocks the tunnel mouth — bigger than any bear they have seen.
A lone survivor staggered into [settlement]. Something smashed the door, took his brother, and left claw marks deep as a spade.
The hunting party from [settlement] never returned. Tracks like a bear, but the kills were deliberate — something man-smart and hungry.
Refugees at [settlement] whisper of a valley where people forget their own names. Pale things with too many eyes — you look away and your friend is gone.
Shepherds from [settlement] will not graze the high moor. The fog moved against the wind and shapes inside it blinked in and out.
Guards from [settlement] heard their own voices calling for help. When they ran toward the sound, they found blood and nothing else.
Children at [settlement] draw black circles for faces. Ten hunters vanished in one night — adults believe the children now.
Gravediggers from [settlement] fled their work. The dead pulled themselves up — rotting limbs, hungry, endless.
A courier reached [settlement] covered in filth. The north road is full of lurching corpses that do not speak and do not tire.
Scouts from [settlement] found a hamlet with doors torn off. Shambling things in the fog — they did not stay to count them.
Fishermen from [settlement] refuse to cast their nets. Pale shapes wait just below the surface — they lunge when you lean too close.
A boy from [settlement] found boats smashed on the reeds. Claw marks on the wood. Something amphibious dragged the men under.
Travelers reached [settlement] half-drowned and raving. A pack of waterlogged corpses guarded the crossing — fast when they leap.
Priests at [settlement] beg for help. Something crawled from the old crypt — hunched, fast, eating the dead.
Orderlies from [settlement] report bodies vanishing from the morgue. Gnawed bones were found outside town.
Watchmen at [settlement] saw a hunched shape leap a wall with a child-sized sack. They need hunters, not guards.
Refugees from [settlement] describe a swollen giant launching spikes at fleeing families, with rotting soldiers following like hounds.
A pilgrim who reached [settlement] sobs about a bloated devil that spat bone darts while smaller dead things finished those who fell.
The chapel bell near [settlement] stopped mid-toll. A huge fleshy monster guards the ruins with shamblers on the cemetery walls.
Hunters from [settlement] argue over what they saw — lion hide, serpent tail, all wrong. It killed three men before they ran.
Ranchers near [settlement] lost an entire herd to three abominations working together with claws and fangs on mismatched skins.
Prospectors fled into [settlement] babbling about stitched-together predators in a cave mouth — parts of many beasts, one hunger.
A militiaman from [settlement] shows acid burns. A leaping mouth on legs swallowed his comrade whole. There may be more.
Children found a pit of polished bones near [settlement]. Something huge hops from shadow to shadow and eats everything.
Campfires outside [settlement] burn all night. Witnesses saw three creatures that devour in one gulp hunting together at dawn.
Servants from [settlement]'s old manor swear a pale stalker drains sleep from its victims with a single touch.
A trader at [settlement] whispers that something which was once a man haunts the mill road and moves between shadows.
Half of [settlement] shares the same nightmare of a thin figure at the foot of the bed. Two farmers have not woken.
A doctor from [settlement] begs discreet help. One of theirs changed overnight — steel under the skin, wrong movements.
Fishers near [settlement] will not sail. A metal figure crawled from a wreck wearing a face they knew.
A farmer from [settlement] reports a neighbor who stopped speaking — when cut, there was no blood, only wire.
